digest.component_or_area: jira-datacenter reconciler live harness and mutation suite
propositions: The reconciler must prove bidirectional data movement against a real Jira Data Center instance using a scrubbed copy of this project's production ticket store, not an empty one, to surface field-mapping and ordering defects.

Isolation requires a separate git repo with no remotes, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credentials in the environment, and no .bridge_state* artifacts in the store copy—all asserted at test time, not assumed.
Every inbound and outbound mutation must round-trip individually and be asserted against a specific oracle, with idempotence verified separately after each direction converges.

Pagination must be exercised by observing the server's effective page size, seeding at least 2*observed+1 issues to force three pages, and asserting full recovery of all seeded issues in the inbound plan.

The working repo's reconciler configuration must point only at the harness (http://localhost:2990/jira), verified by asserting that the set of distinct base_url values in all config files equals exactly that one URL.
